description: Data for "The Challenges of Chinese Regional Energy Transition in Power System and Their Impacts on Air Pollutant Emission Reduction is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wenhan Xi, Jingxu Wang. This dataset includes the following data: 1.capacity inatallation We first predict the provincial new energy capacity installation in 2025 and 2030 (Installation capacity of each new energy under BAU in 2025 and 2030.xlsx) based on the development trend from 2016 to 2023. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
